graph.name: Combine memory with a voice pass
graph.description:
Use independent character and scene appraisals, deterministic composition, and a separate reviewed voice pass.

Lesson: Reusable capstone: two Context/Data appraisal definitions return labeled Text; a third definition composes Guidance. A separate Post package reviews voice patches.

Limitations: Calls execute sequentially. Compose joins Text sections, not Guidance. Pre and Post are separate packages; conflicting appraisals are visible, not automatically resolved.

Opening installs an unassigned copy. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Pre: at most 2 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Open Guarded character; make an editable local copy and change exposed Appraisal instructions. Compare siblings and recorded internal Reflection Data.
Edit the brief template’s section order, then change Post voice strength to Balanced; compare deterministic composition with model revision.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Two appraisals: Character: Mira is guarded after the letter incident. Scene: the ferry is delayed and the letter remains unopened.

Composed brief: Character: let guarded trust shape her response. Scene: preserve the delay and unopened letter. Then review a separate voice revision.

Root sources and effects: Memory sources/Guidance remain root; capture is separate. Separate Post root: Snapshot + reference → voice subgraph → Validate → Review → Apply. No cross-phase wire.

Open the appraisals: Double-click wrappers for pinned internals. Make editable copy is the local-copy action; Add to Subgraphs saves explicitly. Draft contracts use verified hashes when packaged; inspector metadata lives alongside each draft.

Compose Text, then Guidance: Each Reflect returns Data; its own Compose template renders Text. The third definition accepts Text sections, never Guidance sections. Required boundaries stay typed; only safe instructions/token/template controls are exposed.

Calls and review: Pre: two sequential Analysis calls; Text/render/compose deterministic. Post voice subgraph: Prose ≤1. Connections unbound. Review semantic fidelity; Apply stays root, saves may be unconfirmed.

Shared present scene (pre-context)
Purpose: Root source feeds both appraisal Context boundaries.
Fixture: Fixture only: Mira guarded; ferry delayed; letter unopened; Rin still checking harbor. No seed.
Inspect: Check source IDs/omissions.

Root actor state (pre-state)
Purpose: Root source feeds both typed State boundaries.
Inspect: Check scope/version; select Mira.

Root actor episodes (pre-episodes)
Purpose: Root source feeds both typed Episode boundaries.
Inspect: Check IDs/refs; partial actor history.

Guarded character (pre-character)
Purpose: Reflect Data → Compose Text inside a reusable definition.
Inspect: Open body: inspect reflect payload/refs, render Text, typed boundaries.

Scene continuity (pre-scene)
Purpose: Independent Reflect Data → Compose Text definition.
Inspect: Open body: inspect sceneChanges, conflicts and render Text.

Weave the two sections (pre-brief)
Purpose: Two required Text inputs → Compose Guidance boundary.
Inspect: Open body: inspect both Text pins and composed Guidance.

Root writing brief (pre-output)
Purpose: Expose the reusable body’s Guidance at root.
Inspect: Check Host result and unresolved conflicts.

Purpose: Accept root Context without reading host sources internally.
Inspect: Inspect Context boundary and supplied message IDs.

Purpose: Accept the selected actor’s scoped State Data.
Inspect: Inspect Data record type, actor/chat scope and version.

Actor episodes in (pre-character/episodes-in)
Purpose: Accept root actor Episode Data for bounded recall.
Inspect: Inspect episode IDs, exact sourceRefs and matching scope/version.

Guarded character appraisal (pre-character/reflect)
Purpose: Propose character Reflection Data with one Analysis call.
Inspect: Inspect brief, classifications, conflicts and recalledEpisodeIds.

Character appraisal Text (pre-character/render)
Purpose: Render Reflection Data into labeled Text without inference.
Inspect: Inspect exact /payload paths and rendered arrays.

Character Text out (pre-character/text-out)
Purpose: Return Text through the definition’s typed boundary.
Inspect: Inspect Text kind and the parent section connection.
